steps.domain_action: open the empty sheet frame before any coefficient is placed
bind each of the seven coefficients to its row index
pad each coefficient binary to the bit width of m
split the sheet into row reading and column reading
record one bit cells across rows and columns
record zero bit cells across rows and columns
pair each row index with each bit position to name columns
emit the 128 columns as seven bit glyphs
hold the row view and the column view together as one sheet
return each column glyph to its row positions
fuse columns back into the seven padded rows
affirm row values match the input coefficient word
fix the record that two transposes restore the start
close on the restored coefficient word
